title: Check cache, stream and map changes against JVM conformance
description: Check both JBMC and automatic-selection strict corpus tests and automatic confirmation under strict and assume modes on the same source as the Spring resource and cache measurements.
expected: The two proof-tier conformance tests reproduce the recorded JVM outcomes and accepted engine boundaries.

resources.notes: The recorded corpus tests took approximately 11 and 20 minutes individually. They can run beside each other.

steps.name: JBMC, auto and confirmed native conformance
steps.run: JVMCONTRACT_JBMC_MEMORY_MB=2048 python3 lib/tools/test_costs.py run --only rust --tier proof --test conformance --test-threads 2
